title: GenWave Voice Pack Manifest
description: The <slug>.voice-pack.json shape a GenWave station fetches for a kind:"voice-pack" catalog entry (app repo SPEC F164, PLAN T410/T412/T413). A voice pack ships kokoro voice weights (`<voiceId>.pt` torch archives, never unpickled by this catalog's tools — treated as opaque bytes end to end) plus one preview clip. `additionalProperties` is false at every level, closed like ad-pack: an unknown member is a contributor mistake worth failing CI on, not a silent no-op. `engine` is closed to the one value this catalog ships weights for today (`kokoro`) — the app itself accepts any lowercase engine token and does its own compatibility check at install time (SPEC F164.2); this schema is stricter by design, on purpose, so a future engine's pack needs a deliberate schema change, not a silent pass-through. `synthetic` is pinned `true` (F164.3): every voice this catalog carries is a synthesized weight file, never a real person's recorded likeness. `sourceRef`, when present, must be `null` — F164.3's own 'not null or absent' framing is a double negative for 'absent or null both mean no provenance link'; anything else (a string, an object) is a contributor trying to smuggle in identifying provenance this catalog does not carry.

packName.description: Shelf title / attribution name for the pack.

engine.description: The TTS engine these weights were trained/exported for (SPEC F164.2). Closed to `kokoro` — the only engine this catalog carries voice weights for today.

synthetic.description: Always `true` (SPEC F164.3): every voice here is a synthesized weight file, not a recording of a real person.

sourceRef.description: Optional; when present it must be `null` (SPEC F164.3 — absent and null both mean 'no provenance link', anything else is refused). No non-null value is legal in this catalog's manifests.

voices.description: One entry per voice this pack carries. tools/validate.py separately rejects a duplicate `voiceId` across the array (`voice-pack-duplicate-voice`) — `uniqueItems` alone only forbids two IDENTICAL objects, not two voices sharing an id with different gender/age/blend.

voiceId.description: Lowercase voice identifier — the same class the app's SettingValidator.VoiceIdFormat() and db/45's own CHECK constraint enforce, so a pack that validates here installs cleanly there. The `(?![\s\S])` suffix is a portable absolute-end-of-string anchor (Python re's own `$` matches before a trailing newline; `\Z` is not ECMA-262/.NET-portable), matched here for cross-tool consistency even though this schema only ever runs under Python.

file.description: The voice weight filename, sibling to the manifest. Bounded to 67 chars — a 64-char `voiceId` (this same file's own `voiceId.maxLength`) plus the 3-char `.pt` suffix, no more (T411 review round 1 advisory; was 68, one too loose). This schema only pins the SHAPE (a lowercase voiceId-like stem plus `.pt`); tools/validate.py's `voice-pack-file-mismatch` separately pins the stronger rule this schema cannot express — `file` must equal `<voiceId>.pt` for THIS item's own `voiceId`, not merely look like some voice's filename.

blend.description: Optional informational provenance (SPEC F164.3): which stock voices, and in what proportion, this weight was blended from. Never consumed at install or generation time — display-only.

voiceId.description: A stock voice identifier this weight was partly blended from. Not required to be one of THIS pack's own `voices[]` entries — it names a stock voice, which may ship elsewhere.

weight.description: Blend proportion, `(0, 1]`. Not required to sum to 1 across the array — informational only, never renormalized or enforced.

preview.description: The pack's single preview clip filename, sibling to the manifest. This schema only pins the SHAPE (a slug-like stem plus `.preview.mp3`); tools/validate.py's `voice-pack-preview-name` separately pins the stronger rule this schema cannot express — the stem must equal THIS entry's own slug, not merely look like some slug's preview.
